title: Idle Retro Arcade - Fully AI crafted webgame
author: Big-Bag-7504
selftext:
This was my second attempt at creating a webgame in 2026, I'm a good software engineer, I've been doing it since the 90s, but I'm super curious about AI and working with it so I did none of the code at all in this game, I also created all of the sounds with AI and all static images are AI. Other than managing agents, designing and balancing (Using a balance suite I had AI build me) this was crafted by Claude. 

It's available to play here: [https://www.crazygames.com/game/idle-retro-arcade-jwq?bypassCache=zipuu](https://www.crazygames.com/game/idle-retro-arcade-jwq?bypassCache=zipuu)

One of the most fun things about this one is creating all the minigames, most idle games run out of content pretty quick, you have to prestige and then start from the beginning doing it quicker this time until you reach a point where you have so much prestige bonus the game runs out of content and you quit.  
I, well, Claude, built 39 mini cabinets - We created documentation and implementation guides to produce a new one in about an hour, with 2 hours of tweaking, modification and adjustment there's an entire new tier to the game.   
I could have kept going endlessly - The graphics for each game, just like the UI, are vectors drawn by the AI from basic primitives so the art costs remain zero. This is a technique I think I will continue using for a long time, diffusion based art is so obvious and uncanny valley for many players resulting in backlash... Vectors however while not as graphically impressive have charm and character that people associate with being hand crafted and indie.
